headline: Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill 2026 passed by Lok Sabha
summary: The Lok Sabha passed the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 by voice vote amid opposition uproar. The House rejected a proposal for certain amendments to the bill.
why: The Lok Sabha is India's lower house of parliament, and its tax legislation shapes corporate and individual tax obligations. Tax changes affect company earnings and fiscal policy.
